title: Pretraining for Sample-Efficient Neural Interfaces
abstract: arXiv:2609.13507v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) decode neural activity to restore lost function. Typically, training a high-performance neural decoder requires a large labeled dataset to be collected from every new subject. One way to reduce the labeled data cost is self-supervised pretraining, which learns general neural representations from unlabeled recordings that accumulate across subjects. However, for intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) recordings, self-supervised learning has been challenging due to differences in contact placement and neuroanatomy between subjects. We propose MAPA, an otherwise vanilla masked autoencoder with two spatial encodings, an anatomical region embedding and a relative positional encoding, which together enable it to learn neural representations that transfer to unseen subjects and across various tasks. translated_title: 面向样本高效的神经接口预训练
translated_abstract: 脑机接口（BCI）通过解码神经活动来恢复丧失的功能。通常，训练高性能的神经解码器需要为每个新受试者收集大量带标签的数据。降低带标签数据成本的一种方法是自监督预训练，即从跨受试者积累的无标签神经记录中学习通用的神经表征。然而，对于颅内脑电图（iEEG）记录而言，由于受试者之间电极触点位置和神经解剖结构的差异，自监督学习一直面临挑战。我们提出了MAPA，一个本质上普通的掩码自编码器，它采用两种空间编码——解剖区域嵌入和相对位置编码，二者结合使其能够学习可迁移至未见受试者并适用于多种任务的神经表征。MAPA在无需微调的情况下，在Neuroprobe基准的全部三种设置中均创造了新的最先进水平……
tldr: 提出MAPA掩码自编码器，通过解剖区域嵌入与相对位置编码两种空间编码解决iEEG跨受试者差异问题，无需微调即可在Neuroprobe基准上达到新的最先进水平，实现样本高效的神经接口预训练。
en_tdlr: MAPA, a masked autoencoder with anatomical region embedding and relative positional encoding, enables cross-subject self-supervised pretraining for iEEG, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Neuroprobe benchmark without fine-tuning.
